Click this button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp059-img1.png) to open Layers tool.
Manages the visualization of features and calculation results in the Map view. Displays and manages all
layers in the workspace, grouped into categories such as Features, Geodata, Prediction results, and
Other. Each layer can be shown, hidden, or reordered.
![Image p059](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp059-img2.png)
You can reorder the entire group or toggle its visibility to show or hide all layers within it at once.
![Image p060](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp060-img1.png)
Layers can also be organized by dragging them into existing groups or dropping them into **New layer group** to create a custom group.
![Image p060](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp060-img2.png)

Layers added from this panel are visible only to you. Other users who open the same workspace will not
see these layers unless they also add them manually.
![Image p061](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp061-img1.png)
**From URL / Portal ItemID**
Allows you to add a layer directly by entering its URL or Portal Item ID, then selecting Add.
**Search criteria**
**My organization**
Limits search results to layers shared within your organization.
**Owned by me**
Shows only layers you own.
**Sort by**
Determines the order of search results (e.g., by view count or date).

![Image p062](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp062-img1.png)
**Rearrange layers**
Allows you to reorder layers by dragging.
![Image p062](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp062-img2.png)
**Turn on/off the layer**
Turn on or off a layer in the Map view
- The layer is visible - ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp062-img3.png)
- The layer is not visible - ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp062-img4.png)
**Layer symbol**
Preview layer symbol. Click on it to edit the symbol.
![Image p063](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp063-img1.png)
**Expand layer**
Previews and manages the layer opacity and map scale ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp063-img2.png).
![Image p063](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp063-img3.png)

Click on the layer symbol to edit it. A new dialog opens on the right side.
![Image p064](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp064-img1.png)
In layer symbolization it is possible to change:
- Shape.
  - If a path is selected in shape, svg path can be changed.
- Size.
- Color.
- Turn on and off outline.
- Outline color.
- Turn on and off offset.
- X/Y offset.
![Image p065](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp065-img1.png)
There is an option to use 3d symbol. The following parameters can be changed in the 3d symbol:
- Shape
- Color
- Width
- Height
- Tilt
Visual variables can be added for each layer. Add visual variables to a layer using the *Add visual variable* dropdown.
![Image p065](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp065-img2.png)
Choose a visual variable. The choices are:
- Color.
- Size.
- Rotation.
- Opacity.
![Image p066](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp066-img1.png)
**Accept**
Saves all changes.
**Cancel**
Discards all changes and closes the dialog.

The prediction rasters calculated in Cellular Expert Express and loaded in the map view will appear in the
Layers tool.
![Image p067](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp067-img1.png)
**Rearrange layers**
Allows you to reorder layers by dragging.
![Image p067](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp067-img2.png)
**Turn on/off the layer**
Turn on or off a layer in the Map view
- The layer is visible - ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp067-img3.png)
- The layer is not visible - ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp067-img4.png)
**Expand layer**
Expand the layer so you can see and edit the symbology.
For these types of layers, the visualization can be edited in the following ways:
- Add threshold using *Add color band* button ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img1.png)
- Adjust threshold value ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img2.png)
- Adjust color band ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img3.png)
- Adjust color opacity ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img4.png)
- Delete threshold using *Delete band* button
![Image p068](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img5.png)
Upon hovering the mouse over a prediction result item, options for it appear.
![Image p068](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp068-img6.png)
**Rename layer**
![Image p069](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp069-img1.png)
**Publish to portal**
![Image p069](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp069-img2.png)
**Zoom to layer**
![Image p069](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp069-img3.png)
**Compare**
[Compare](#kw:98-compare-predictions:ce-pro-rcp)
![Image p069](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp069-img4.png)
**Remove layer**
![Image p069](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp069-img5.png)

It is possible to create symbology presets. This means that when a prediction raster is loaded, a symbology
preset can be used:
![Image p070](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img1.png)
To create a preset, first define the bands and colors, then press *New color band preset* button.
![Image p070](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img2.png)
Define a preset name.
![Image p070](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img3.png)
A new preset will be created.
![Image p070](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img4.png)
The defined preset will be applied the next time when the raster will be loaded.
**Apply**
Applies a preset symbology for the current prediction raster layer.

The Swipe widget enables you to easily [compare](#kw:98-compare-predictions:ce-pro-rcp) the content of different layers in a map. Mouse over the
layers you want to compare and press the compare button.
![Image p070](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img5.png)
When the first ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img6.png) and second ![icon](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp070-img7.png) layers are selected for comparison, a swipe widget will appear on
the map. Slide the swipe tool to compare different layers.
![Image p071](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp071-img1.png)

Raster prediction results may be individually published to portal by using the publish to portal button.
Upon clicking this button, publishing settings will appear:
![Image p071](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp071-img2.png)
Set up the publishing options and click OK to start the publishing process.

This section appears when enabled in the settings.
![Image p072](http://localhost:4000/api/synced-images?path=docs%2Fassets%2Fimages%2Fce-express%2Fuser-guide-v73%2Fp072-img1.png)
